name: Faith Summers
source:
Faith is a bit of an introvert, preferring to keep mostly to herself. The exception is her close friends and the animals on campus. Faith is the president of the garden club and she takes her responsibilities very seriously. She may be a kind heart, but do not ever cross her friends. She will make you regret it. That goes for the animals, too.

[From [url=http://www.zap-apple.com/p/characters.html]the Starswirl Academy characters page[/url]]
